text: At its meeting in July 2021, Council approved an exemption for the implementation of permit parking on Davenport Road, between Berryman Street and New Street from the requirements City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 925, Permit Parking. http://app.toronto.ca/tmmis/viewAgendaItemHistory.do?item=2021.TE26.80 Subsection 925-4B of Chapter 925, provides that: Where permit parking is not currently available and where a petition requesting permit parking signed by the residents of a minimum of 25% of the total number of residential premises having a residential address on the street or the flank of the street is submitted to the General Manager, a poll shall be conducted in accordance with Chapter 190, Polling and Notification, to determine if the residents wish to have permit parking on their road or area, as the case may be. In the event of a positive polling result, the General Manager…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended Schedule A of City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate the west side of Davenport Road, between Berryman Street and New Street, as part of area 5E, under the operating hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week.
